\section{\texttt{groundedness\_score}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.evaluation.groundedness_score}\index{Functions!groundedness\_score}

Fraction of answer sentences whose content words appear in the context.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
groundedness_score(answer: str, context_texts: list[str]) -> float
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{answer}] \texttt{str}, required.
  \item[\texttt{context\_\allowbreak{}texts}] \texttt{list[str]\allowbreak{}}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{float}
\apifield{Details}A sentence counts as supported when at least half of its content tokens occur in the retrieved context. This is a lexical proxy for claim support: cheap, deterministic, and good at catching answers that drift away from the retrieved evidence.
